prompt: Tell me about Philippo di Vadi
response: Philippo di Vadi was an Italian physician and mathematician who lived during the Renaissance. He is best known for his work "Trattato di medicina militare" (Treatise on Military Medicine), which was one of the first books dedicated to military medicine. In this work, he emphasized the importance of hygiene, nutrition, and preventive medicine in military settings. He also wrote about the use of mathematics in medicine, including the calculation of dosages.
